_meta.description: Permanent cache of BabelNet lookups, and the per-day request counter. Entries never expire — BabelNet changes only between releases — and are NOT scoped to an organization, because they hold public lexical facts rather than anybody's data. Sharing one cache across every crawl in the deployment is what makes a 1000-request daily allowance workable. Payloads are stored but not indexed: they are opaque API responses, only ever read back by key.
